title: Feature: agent office, part 2: walk around the 3D venue
body:
### What it should do
This replaces #22 (written for the old flat office). The agent office is now a 3D-style venue seen from a corner. The agents stand at their stations with their floor rings, thought bubbles and tap-for-card already working. Bring them to life the way people move in a life-simulation game: **working** agents walk around the venue on their own route and do their job; **finished** agents wave at their spot; **needs a look** agents stand still with their red flag; **resting** agents stay put.

- **Test customer:** walks between the two game tables and the bar, stopping to tap its phone.
- **Technical agent:** stays behind the front desk, typing (arms bobbing). It never leaves: the desk hides its legs.
- **Builder:** walks along the stage and hammers.
- **Reviewer:** walks a loop around the room with its clipboard: center, beside the bar, behind Icee's desk.
- **Pull request checks:** paces just inside the entrance, then walks to the center and back, as if checking people in.
- **Backup:** carries its box from beside Roy's office door to the storage gap and back.
- **String lights** (`.agbulb` with `.b0`, `.b1`, `.b2`): a slow twinkle, brighter at night (`.agscene.night`).

### Who uses it
Roy and staff

### Where in the app
Admin console → Agents (`agScene`, `agFigure`, `agPerson` in js/18-support-staff.js; styles under "the agent office" in css/games.css)

### Done when
- [ ] Each working agent walks its route, swinging its legs, and faces the way it walks
- [ ] Nobody walks through the stage edge, a table, a desk, the bar or a wall
- [ ] The thought bubble and floor ring move with the agent
- [ ] Tapping a walking agent still opens its card (the invisible `.aghit` rectangle moves with it)
- [ ] Finished agents wave; agents that need a look stand still with their flag
- [ ] With the phone's "reduce motion" setting on, nothing moves (`@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)`)
- [ ] Smooth on a phone: CSS animations of `transform` only, no JavaScript timers
- [ ] The agent office check in agents/regressions.json still passes
- [ ] `bash agents/check_all.sh` passes

### Notes for the builder (how the venue is built: read before starting)
- Claude built part 1 by hand (commit "Agent office: Sims-style 3D venue"). Follow its pattern; don't redraw the room.
- Everything is ONE SVG (`viewBox 0 0 400 290`), drawn back to front by depth (`parts`, sorted by i + j). The floor is a 10 by 10 grid; `agP(a, b, z)` turns a floor spot into a screen point: x = 200 + (a - b) * 18, y = 90 + (a + b) * 9 - z.
- Each agent is `<g class="agw r-NAME STATE" transform="translate(X Y)">` (its home spot, from `AG_SPOT`), and inside it `<g class="agmove">` holds the ring, the person, the bubble and the tap area. **Animate `.agmove` with `transform: translate(dx, dy)`** in scene units, measured from the agent's home. Don't animate `.agw` itself (its transform attribute places it).
- Facing: add a `scaleX(-1)` on the person's `svg.agp` while walking left (a second keyframes with `step-end` timing at the same moments). Keep the bubble the right way round.
- The person's parts (inside `agPerson`): `.agbod`, `.agleg-l`, `.agleg-r` (swing in turn for walking), `.agarm` (front arm: hammer, phone, clipboard, wave), `.agarm-b`, `.agcarry` (backup's box), `.agflag`. Their pivots are set already (`transform-origin` with `transform-box: view-box`): rotate them, don't move them.
- Agents keep their place in the depth order while walking, so plan routes through open floor (the aisles below) and keep each one on its own side of the furniture.
- Colors: navy #16255a, orange #f6892f, green #2f8a4c only.
- Don't change how status is worked out (`agState`, `agNews`, `agLatestRun`) or the card (`agPanel`).

Spots you can use (floor grid a, b, raise z, and the screen point):

| Spot | Floor (a, b, z) | Screen x, y |
| --- | --- | --- |
| tester home (by the game tables) | (4.9, 5.6) | 187.4, 184.5 |
| tech home (behind the front desk) | (2.1, 6.75) | 116.3, 169.6 |
| builder home (on the stage, raised 8) | (8, 1.7, 8) | 313.4, 169.3 |
| reviewer home | (7.3, 8.7) | 174.8, 234.0 |
| pull request checks home (inside the entrance) | (1.6, 3.7) | 162.2, 137.7 |
| backup home (outside storage) | (3.2, 1.5) | 230.6, 132.3 |
| aisle: center of the room | (5.5, 5.5) | 200.0, 189.0 |
| aisle: in front of the stage | (6.5, 4.2) | 241.4, 186.3 |
| aisle: beside the bar | (7.6, 6.5) | 219.8, 216.9 |
| aisle: behind Icee's desk | (4.6, 8.0) | 138.8, 203.4 |
| aisle: near the entrance | (2.4, 4.6) | 160.4, 153.0 |
| aisle: by Roy's office door | (4.8, 1.6) | 257.6, 147.6 |
| storage gap (between the partitions) | (2.6, 1.35) | 222.5, 125.6 |
| stage steps (front edge, raised 8) | (7.0, 3.0, 8) | 272.0, 172.0 |

To get a translate for a route, subtract the agent's home screen point from the target's screen point.

_Split between Claude and the builder on Nov 3, 2026, so the builder works from a clear pattern. Start the builder by adding the `claude` label._
